name: Fezola
description: Multi-account connector for Claude and ChatGPT: Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and any IMAP mailbox, Google Chat, Telegram (read-only), Google Calendar, Notion and ad platforms (Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, OpenAI Ads; changes are validated or simulated first where supported, new campaigns start paused). Unified search across accounts, a daily briefing, reply drafts saved in the right mailbox (direct sending only if enabled). Hosted closed-source service with OAuth 2.1 sign-in, free for 2 sources (the linked repo holds docs and client configs) · [Docs](https://app.fezola.com/en/docs)
